content: Rohan Deshmukh shared the signed policy PDF with agent Sunita Agarwal. Sunita verified the signature, uploaded it, and provided a payment link for the ₹18,750 premium. After Rohan encountered a payment gateway error, Sunita generated a fresh link. Rohan successfully completed the payment, and Sunita confirmed she would update him once the policy status changes from Pending to Active.

action_items: Sunita to confirm payment and update the policy status from Pending to Active
